summary: Preserve off() as the removeListener() alias, including duplicate and once-wrapper behavior.

target.notes: off is an alias for removeListener and must share the same identity/removal semantics.

caveats: If off is overwritten, normal dynamic property/call semantics take precedence.

tests.name: off removes listener
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); let n=0; const f=()=>n++; e.on('x',f); e.off('x',f); e.emit('x'); console.log(n);

tests.name: off only removes one duplicate
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); let n=0; function f(){n++} e.on('x',f); e.on('x',f); e.off('x',f); e.emit('x'); console.log(n);
